create_ntuple_network: create an NTupleNetwork with configurable tuple size, max index, and tuple definitions for 2048 state evaluation
run_td_learning_2048: run TD learning with N-tuple networks to train an agent on the 2048 game for a specified number of episodes
evaluate_state_value: evaluate the value of a 2048 game state using N-tuple network look-up tables and observation tensors
select_best_action: select the best action for a 2048 state by evaluating all legal actions with the N-tuple network evaluator
update_network_weights: update N-tuple network weights using temporal difference learning after each training episode
